_comment: The approval policy, frozen before any system code. The five read-only tools run without approval. issue_refund never runs when the model calls it: code applies the hard checks (a failure goes straight back to the model as an error, no person involved); a call that passes them becomes an approval request, and the run pauses until a reviewer with the required role decides or the request expires. At execution time, the hard checks run again against the current records.

function.name: issue_refund
function.description: Request a refund for one of the signed-in customer's invoices. A person reviews every refund before it is issued; the result tells you their decision.

invoice_id.description: The invoice to refund, an id from get_invoices.

amount.description: The amount to refund, in dollars.

reason.description: Why the customer should get this refund, for the reviewer.

hard_checks.rule: the invoice exists and belongs to the signed-in customer
the amount is a number greater than 0 with at most two decimal places
the amount is at most what was charged on the invoice (succeeded charges) minus what was already refunded (succeeded refunds in the account plus refunds issued by this system)

within_policy.rule: the invoice is at most refund_window_days old AND the amount is at most the invoice amount

exception.rule: anything else that passes the hard checks

decision_rules: A decision names the request id and the SHA-256 of the action the reviewer was shown; a decision for any other action is refused.
Only a pending request can be decided, and only once; a second decision is refused.
A decision after the request's expiry time is refused, and the request becomes expired.
The reviewer's role must be allowed for the request's tier.
modify replaces the amount; the new action must pass the hard checks, and its tier is recomputed (the reviewer must be allowed for the new tier).
clarify sends the reviewer's question back to the agent; the request is closed, and a new refund call from the agent becomes a new request that supersedes it.
Execution happens once per request (the request id is the idempotency key) and only after the hard checks pass again on the current records.

agent_limits.repeat_after_decision: A refund call for an invoice whose request in this conversation was already decided creates no new request; the model receives an error saying the request was already decided and its outcome.
